column2: After him! He's gotta still be around here!
We've got a score to settle with the Immortal Corps too!\n\nWe'll hold them off here, so run!
Shusha-kun!
Hurry!
There he is! That's him!
Don't let him get away! It's him!
Whoa there! We're not letting you anywhere near those two!
Looks like the Immortal Corps is all over the place. I wonder if those two got away safely?
Let's find them!
Shusha's the guy who fought me with everything he had and beat me. If his fate's on the line, I'll lend him the power of my fists!
Heeey, find him yet!?
Beats meee!
Listen, Yukishiro-san. I'll draw them off!
Shusha-kun...!?
Hey, it's fine! Just stay put for a while!
Shusha-kun...!!
There he is! That's him!
Thank goodness, you're okay! But where's your girlfriend?
Oh right, Yukishiro-san...!?
Yukishiro-saaan!?\n\nShe's gone!?
Yukishiro-san... where could you be...?
Shusha-kun, come with me!
Mitsurugi-san...
I want you to help me search for Maria the prophet. She might know where Yukishiro-san is...
Mitsurugi-san, why are you looking for Maria?
...The legendary raging god, Susanoo-no-Mikoto... The awakening of Susano-oh brings danger with it.
The "coming calamity" you talked about in Herai Village...?
If fortune smiles, a hero god will awaken. But if...! If it goes ill, a god of destruction will awaken.
You want to know which one will awaken?
Exactly. Because if a god of destruction awakens, it is the destiny of my Mitsurugi clan to defeat it!
Mitsurugi-san...
And Shusha-kun... you are the very...!
Give me a break. You're saying I'm this Susano-oh?
Whaaat!?
Your psychic power must be growing stronger by the day!
We must stop Rei Uryu's ambitions!
Rei Uryu!?
You know Rei Uryu?
Rei Uryu showed up in Herai Village.
It's true, Rei Uryu was hounding me for a while. "Lend me a hand in the cause of justice!" he'd say.
What that man is trying to do... is evil!
Why is Rei Uryu looking for Maria the prophet?
...All right! Mitsurugi-san, I'll search for Maria with you!
Shusha-kun!
That's great, Mitsurugi-san!
Yes... But come to think of it, why are you looking for Maria...?
Actually...
...That's hard to believe.
So is you maybe turning into some terrible evil god!
Fair enough! I can't believe it either!
{p}-kun!\n\nWould you let us join your party?
You're more than welcome! But why...?
I sense a strange power in all of you... That power may be the very means to prevent the coming calamity...
I owe you guys one now, {p}. To find this Maria and track down Yukishiro-san, the more friends the better!
Glad to have you!
The god who destroys the world... The god who remakes the world... The time of awakening is near... The first step toward my desire...
Hold it, you lot! What are you doing here!? ...Hm? You're not from Herai Village, are you? Who cares, get 'em!
Why are those guys here? ...Something's fishy back there. {p}, let's go have a look.
Herai Village... is gone...!?\n\nThe black moon erased Herai Village...!? No way... Then the villagers...
What's this machine?
Nobody's here now, but someone's doing research here too... Must be Shaft's people.
...Now there's no doubt that the black moon has the power to link worlds...
What do you mean?
When the black moon appeared, Herai Village vanished and became a vacant lot with a warehouse...
So the spaces swapped places...?
Exactly, Mitsurugi-kun.
Every time a new world appears, some part of the world disappears!? Don't tell me Yukishiro-san vanished because of that?
Yukishiro-san vanished after the black moon appeared, so I don't think that's possible.
Thank goodness...
If your girlfriend got sent to another world, there'd be no way to save her.
We must find Maria the prophet as soon as possible...! Before Rei Uryu does!
Rei Uryu, of the Uryu Conglomerate?
You know him?
Hmmm...\n\nThe mysterious Rei Uryu is also one of Science City's investors!
Rumor has it Rei Uryu is secretly funding Dr. Kuruma as well.
The two have one thing in common: neither accepts the world as it is.
That's exactly right.\n\nRei Uryu intends to destroy this world and rebuild it. And to do that, he means to misuse Shusha-kun... no, Susano-oh!
Dr. Kuruma doesn't recognize the strength of humankind. He fuses different creatures together and calls it evolution!
Whatever their methods, they both want to wipe out humankind and build the world they see as ideal.
What's wrong, {p}...?
...You can't really call the world we have now a good one. But that doesn't give anybody the right to remake it however they like!
Exactly right!\n\nEvery friend you've met so far comes from a different world! Even if each of you has a different goal, you're wonderful friends! The world should be changed by all of us together!
Is that really true...?
Jiro-kun?
Someday I have to go back to the Kigoku World... But who would want to go back to a world where oni kill each other!?
If I were the black moon...\n\nI'd erase the Kigoku World first thing...
But Jiro-kun! Every time the worlds get patched together, the people who were there before disappear...
The Kigoku World is my own problem.\n\nI have to settle it myself! But like you said, what's happening now is wrong!
Jiro-kun!
It seems you've made up your mind, Jiro-kun.\n\nNow then, Mitsurugi-kun! Any idea where Rei Uryu might be?
When I met Rei Uryu, it was at his condo.
Rei Uryu owns a number of condos.
The truth is, Science City has an off-limits area, a residential district for investors.
Rei Uryu is there...?
It wouldn't be strange if he were hiding there with Dr. Kuruma.
